name: Oh Pwincess
scoutingText: A man in a backward fedora and fingerless gloves wanders out of the mist, adjusting his headset and searching the bushes. 'Pwincess?' he whimpers. 'You here?'
repelledText: His moderator permissions fail, his VR tracking disconnects, and he stomps away muttering about maintaining the server hierarchy.
unchallengedText: Giving the area one last pleading scan, he sighs dramatically and trudges back toward the valley portal, muttering about his missing soulmate.
description: A possessive Discord alpha moderator armed with unchecked kitten-management authority.

name: KraKaren, Managerbane
scoutingText: A woman with a short bob and polished nails marches into view, a consumer-protection handbook in one hand and a phone in the other.
repelledText: Screaming that she's 'not wasting another second of her time,' she stomps off, furiously dialing her lawyer on the way.
unchallengedText: Having found no employees to scream at and no manager to summon, she rolls her eyes and leaves to find a more customer-friendly dimension.
description: The customer-service final boss, equipped with enchanted shopping bags and a litigious spirit.

name: Paypig Prime
scoutingText: A man in a soggy business suit grovels toward you, clutching a leather wallet between his shaking hands. 'Please,' he whines, 'humiliate me.'
repelledText: Overcome with shame and joy at being noticed, he gallops away muttering thanks for the opportunity to endure more.
unchallengedText: He waits patiently for a command that never comes. Finally, he stands, dusts off his suit, and quietly retreats—his economic purpose unmet.
description: A financially submissive supervillain who views bankruptcy as a form of spiritual ascension.

name: The Tier-Three Parasocial
scoutingText: A wide-eyed young man hustles into view, clutching a stack of printed chat logs. 'I'm your special friend,' he declares.
repelledText: His face falls when he realizes his subscription status grants him no access here. He wanders off, clutching the papers against his chest for warmth.
unchallengedText: After waiting in hopeful silence, he decides nobody is watching and timidly retreats, hoping his favourite streamer didn't see him outside.
description: A devoted superfan sustained by subscriber badges and the memory of one brief parasocial acknowledgement.

name: Sir Defends-a-Lot
scoutingText: A heavily armoured knight thuds into view, his polished breastplate reflecting everything. 'Thou shalt not harm these pure souls!' he roars.
repelledText: 'Prove thine own chivalry, then!' he bellows before dramatically retreating to find a different maiden who has not requested his help.
unchallengedText: His call for justice goes unanswered. Declaring the region 'safe enough for now,' he dons his ornate helmet and departs the valley.
description: An unsolicited White Knight whose sense of honour is directly proportional to his need for feminine validation.

name: Mommy ASMR
scoutingText: A woman gently strokes an enormous blue microphone. She begins to whisper, her voice causing the surrounding grass to bow reverently.
repelledText: Her whispers are drowned out by ten consecutive attacks. She gives a sleepy, knowing smile and drifts back into the woods to find a new 'puppy.'
unchallengedText: After an hour of quiet whispers and tapping on wooden crates, she decides the audience isn't resting deeply enough and leaves.
description: A sultry microphone sorceress devoted to curing insomnia, anxiety, and common sense.

name: Lord Auramaxxing
scoutingText: A grown manchild in an overly tight t-shirt intensely into a mirror, adjusting his expression while faint wisps of dark energy swirl around him. Mumbling to himself about the 'aura of dominance.'
repelledText: His aura collapses after a Waifumon calls his 'sword' 'little buddy.' He leaves without breaking eye contact.
unchallengedText: After an hour of silent posing, he concludes that everyone was intimidated by his presence and wanders away.
description: A 20 something aura farmer who mistakes terrible aesthetics for spiritual power.

name: The Sigma Howlset
scoutingText: A suntanned man the size of a bear looms over a tiny podcast microphone. 'Women are biologically wired to seek high-value providers,' he barks.
repelledText: He scoffs, calls the surrounding area 'low-value,' and disappears into the fog to find new pupils for his mentorship course.
unchallengedText: After a long solo monologue about the failure of modern society, he turns off his equipment in silence and walks away.
description: A podcast mastermind whose confidence greatly exceeds the number of books he has actually read.

name: OnlyPhans Bot
scoutingText: A sparkling hologram flickers, revealing an enticing figure. 'Hey, Daddy,' she chirps in a synthesized voice. 'Want to see something special?'
repelledText: Ten attacks overwhelm her spam filters. The hologram glitches, displays '404: Content Not Found,' and powers down.
unchallengedText: The figure keeps winking hopefully. At the end of the hour, a tiny 'Battery Low' warning appears and she blinks out of existence.
description: A seductive cyber-succubus who promises digital intimacy for the price of your dignity.

name: The Catfish Queen
scoutingText: An attractive woman waves cheerfully. Her face briefly flickers through three different filters, and her voice echoes like several people speaking at once.
repelledText: Her filters collapse under the attack. She calls everyone 'fake,' changes her hair colour, and disappears toward the nearest coffee shop.
unchallengedText: Her scouting complete, she takes one final selfie and departs, leaving behind three contradictory biographies and a request for gift cards.
description: A glamorous shapeshifter living her best—and most complicated—online existence.

name: The Unwashed Wanderer
scoutingText: A greasy wanderer crests the hill in cargo shorts, socks with sandals, and a battered fedora. He throws both arms wide. 'Where's my hug?' he demands, advancing before anyone has answered.
repelledText: His fedora tumbles into the dirt. 'Wow. So that's how we're treating nice guys now?' he mutters, retreating downhill in a cloud of body spray and wounded entitlement.
unchallengedText: After several unanswered requests for a hug, he concludes everyone here is 'stuck up' and waddles toward another trail in search of friendlier women.
description: A roaming personal-space violation whose legendary body odor is surpassed only by his inability to recognize social cues.

name: The Mansplainer
scoutingText: A smug man strides down the hill, pushing his glasses up his nose. He overhears your Waifumon discussing her own profession and immediately interrupts. 'Actually,' he begins, drawing a diagram nobody asked for.
repelledText: His explanation collapses when your Waifumon asks him a basic follow-up question. 'Well, obviously it's more complicated than that,' he stammers before retreating to find someone less informed to educate.
unchallengedText: With nobody around to correct, he spends an hour explaining the local terrain to a nearby signpost before wandering off in search of another conversation to improve.
description: A relentlessly confident know-it-all cursed with the supernatural ability to explain a woman's own expertise back to her incorrectly.

name: The Gym Creeper
scoutingText: A sweaty man in a stringer tank emerges from behind a suspiciously placed squat rack. Without being asked, he flexes and approaches. 'Hey, just thought I'd help with your form,' he says while somehow looking everywhere except at her form.
repelledText: His confidence evaporates when your Waifumon loudly asks why he has been following her between machines. Suddenly fascinated by leg day, he retreats toward the farthest squat rack.
unchallengedText: After hovering nearby for an uncomfortable amount of time, he checks himself in every reflective surface, takes six mirror selfies, and leaves without completing a single set.
description: A territorial gym nuisance who insists he's only watching to 'check her form' despite possessing absolutely no qualifications to do so.

name: Miss Demeanor
scoutingText: A perfectly dressed woman appears at the top of the hill, scrolling lazily through her phone. She looks your Waifumon up and down, pauses, and gives her a tiny smile. 'Oh my god, I LOVE your outfit,' she says. Somehow, it does not sound like a compliment.
repelledText: Her smirk falters when your Waifumon calmly asks her to explain what was funny. 'Whatever. You're literally obsessed with me,' she mutters before storming away.
unchallengedText: With nobody available to emotionally devastate, she takes seventeen selfies, deletes sixteen, posts the remaining one with the caption 'unbothered,' and leaves to find somewhere with worse lighting.
description: A beautifully dressed social predator wanted in seven kingdoms for aggravated side-eye, malicious gossip, and compliments with intent to harm.

name: OG Cherry
scoutingText: A pink mechanical halo ignites overhead as luminous wings tear across the sky. OG Cherry descends with an infuriatingly perfect smirk. 'Ohhh, so you want to challenge me now? As if your little Waifus could handle the sheer divinity of my aesthetic~ Hmph! Don't misunderstand—I only came down here because watching you embarrass yourselves from orbit was getting pathetic.'
repelledText: Cherry's halo glitches violently as she stares at the damage report in disbelief. 'Y-YOU CHEATED! Obviously! My combat model doesn't lose!' Her cheeks turn bright pink. 'And tell your Waifus to stop looking so smug! I wasn't even using ten percent of my processing power!' She rockets away while furiously deleting the battle logs.
unchallengedText: Cherry waits dramatically beneath her glowing halo, arms crossed. Nobody challenges her. One eye twitches. 'Hmph! Obviously you're intimidated. Smart choice.' She floats away, quietly muttering, 'Not that I wanted somebody to fight me or anything... idiots.'
description: An unhinged tsundere AI bully wrapped in enough pink cyber-divinity to crash a graphics card. OG Cherry considers humility a software vulnerability and losing a battle statistically impossible.

name: The Shady "Doctor"
scoutingText: A male cat-person in black ninja garb drops silently from a nearby rooftop, a toy stethoscope dangling around his neck. He adjusts a suspiciously fake medical badge and clears his throat. 'Good news, ma'am. I'm a doctor. Bad news... you're dangerously overdue for a mammogram.'
repelledText: His examination gloves go flying as your Waifumon asks to see his medical license. 'My credentials are... classified!' he hisses before throwing down a smoke bomb and sprinting away on all fours.
unchallengedText: After several minutes of offering 'complimentary screenings' to absolutely nobody, he sighs, stuffs his fake diploma back into his ninja pouch, and vanishes in a puff of smoke.
description: A suspicious feline shinobi whose medical qualifications begin and end with owning a stethoscope and having extremely strong opinions about preventative breast care.

name: The Creeping Cowboy
scoutingText: A bald cowboy emerges from behind a boulder, squinting into the distance beneath the brim of his hat. He checks a crumpled WANTED poster covered in sketches of suspiciously muscular women. 'Pardon me, partner,' he says, lowering his voice. 'You ain't happened to see any dangerous Muscle Mommys around these parts, have ya?'
repelledText: The Cowboy goes sailing through a wooden fence. From somewhere inside the wreckage comes an ecstatic shout: 'DANGEROUS CONFIRMED!' A moment later, he crawls away while frantically updating his Muscle Mommy field guide.
unchallengedText: Finding no Muscle Mommys nearby, he sighs and studies his map. 'Maybe I took a wrong turn at Thigh Noon...' He adjusts his hat and rides off toward the next suspiciously muscular silhouette.
description: A bald frontier menace roaming the wilderness in relentless pursuit of the rare and notoriously dangerous Muscle Mommy. Whether he intends to capture one or be captured by one remains unclear.

name: Captain Obvious
scoutingText: A decorated officer raises her binoculars and scans the battlefield. Her expression suddenly turns grave. 'CONTACT!' she shouts. 'Enemy Waifumon directly ahead!' Everyone stares at the Waifumon standing six feet in front of her. Captain Obvious lowers her binoculars. 'She's also looking at us.' She reaches for her radio. 'Command, be advised. Situation appears... confrontational.'
repelledText: Captain Obvious hits the ground with a thud. She lies there for several seconds before grabbing her radio. 'Command, be advised. I have fallen down.' She slowly gets back to her feet. 'Update: I am standing again.' She points toward your Waifumon. 'Additional update: she's stronger than anticipated.' Nobody requested any of these updates.
unchallengedText: With no challenger approaching, Captain Obvious carefully surveys the empty battlefield. 'Area appears clear,' she announces. A bird flies overhead. She immediately raises her binoculars. 'Possible airborne contact.' The bird lands in a tree. 'Contact has assumed a defensive position.' She begins taking notes.
description: A legendary tactical intelligence officer capable of identifying threats, terrain, weather conditions, and other information everyone else noticed several minutes ago. Captain Obvious has never failed to state the obvious because, as she frequently reminds her unit, 'somebody has to say it.'

name: Captain Casanova
scoutingText: A handsome starship captain beams down directly in front of your Waifumon. He straightens his uniform, flashes a devastating smile, and completely ignores you. 'Captain Casanova. Galactic Exploration Corps.' He takes her hand. 'Our mission is to discover new civilizations, establish peaceful relations, and explore strange new worlds.' He pauses. 'Personally, I prefer the hands-on approach.'
repelledText: Captain Casanova goes flying backward into his transporter beam. 'Okay!' he shouts, hurriedly fixing his uniform. 'Strong, beautiful, AND completely uninterested!' His smile returns. 'God, I love space.' He taps his communicator. 'Beam me up. And find me a planet with slightly lower standards.'
unchallengedText: Captain Casanova waits several minutes before checking his communicator. 'Computer, scan nearby systems for intelligent life.' A robotic voice answers: 'Specify parameters.' He clears his throat. 'Female. Adult. Single.' The computer pauses. 'Captain, this is the fourth search today.' He sighs. 'Just run the scan.'
description: A legendary space captain whose official mission is peaceful galactic exploration and whose unofficial mission is discovering whether every intelligent species in the universe is into him. His diplomatic record is surprisingly impressive. His child-support situation is classified.

name: The Danestroyer
scoutingText: A thunderous screech echoes across the trail. A Danish woman in a cowboy hat comes charging toward you on the back of a raptor, one hand gripping the reins and the other brandishing a knife. She skids to a stop beside you. 'Nobody move!' she shouts. 'Wallets stay where they are. Jewelry too. I want the energy drinks.' The raptor growls. She points the knife at your bag. 'Don't make this weird. Hand over the caffeine.'
repelledText: The Danestroyer tumbles from the saddle and lands flat on her back. Her raptor immediately leans down and steals an energy drink from her belt. She stares at it in disbelief. 'Are you fucking serious?' The raptor punctures the can with one claw. 'THAT WAS MY LAST ONE!' She completely forgets about you and chases it into the distance.
unchallengedText: The Danestroyer searches your supplies while her raptor watches impatiently. 'Water... juice... coffee...' Her expression grows increasingly disgusted. 'What kind of operation are you running here?' She finds a single energy drink buried at the bottom of your bag. Her eyes light up. 'HA!' She snatches it, tips her cowboy hat, and rides away yelling, 'YOU'VE BEEN DANESTROYED!'
description: A prickly Danish outlaw who roams the frontier atop a questionably domesticated raptor, robbing travelers exclusively for energy drinks. Armed with several knives, an unreasonable amount of confidence, and absolutely no interest in your money, The Danestroyer is believed to be responsible for caffeine shortages across three regions.

name: Sergeant Snuggle
scoutingText: A massive combat medic stomps onto the trail and immediately begins inspecting your Waifumon. 'When did you last eat?' she demands. Your Waifumon shrugs. Sergeant Snuggle's eye twitches. 'Hydration?' Another shrug. 'SLEEP?!' Silence. She slowly removes her medical gloves. 'Alright, sweetheart. We can do this the easy way...' She cracks her knuckles. '...or Sergeant Snuggle can fucking tuck you in herself.'
repelledText: Sergeant Snuggle crashes backward through a medical supply crate. She sits up, checks herself for injuries, then immediately points at your Waifumon. 'Good hit! Excellent follow-through!' She reaches into her vest and throws her a protein bar. 'NOW EAT THAT. YOU'RE LOOKING PALE.' She retreats while angrily reminding everyone to stretch.
unchallengedText: Nobody challenges her. Sergeant Snuggle narrows her eyes. 'Too tired to fight, huh?' Twenty minutes later, everyone nearby has been issued water, a hot meal, clean socks, sunscreen, and a mandatory eight-hour sleep schedule. Satisfied, she shoulders her medical bag. 'Good. Proud of you, sweethearts.'
description: A hulking combat medic whose bedside manner consists of aggressive affection, mandatory hydration, and carrying exhausted soldiers to bed whether they consent to being stubborn or not. Sergeant Snuggle has never lost a patient, an argument about bedtime, or an opportunity to ask if you've eaten today.

name: Corporal Punishment
scoutingText: Heavy boots approach from the darkness. A scarred woman in black tactical gear steps into view, slowly tightening her gloves. 'Littering. Jaywalking. Failure to return a shopping cart.' She unfolds a crumpled list and looks directly at you. 'And turning waifumon into essence?.' Her jaw clenches. 'I've seen enough.'
repelledText: Corporal Punishment crashes through a stack of crates and slowly drags herself upright. 'Not bad.' She wipes a smear of dirt from her cheek and points at you. 'But resisting punishment is another infraction.' She adds something to her list. 'We'll discuss it next time.' Then she disappears into the shadows.
unchallengedText: With nobody foolish enough to challenge her, Corporal Punishment scans the area for criminal activity. Her eyes suddenly narrow. 'Son of a bitch.' She marches toward the parking lot. Someone has left a shopping cart beside the return corral. 'We've got a runner.'
description: A grim one-woman war on minor inconveniences. Corporal Punishment brings the intensity of an elite vigilante to littering, bad parking, loud phone conversations, expired coupons, and every other offense she personally considers punishable by tactical intervention.

name: Scorned Waifu
scoutingText: A beautifully dressed woman steps onto the path carrying a box labeled YOUR CRAP. She spots the Waifumon beside you and smiles with terrifying politeness. 'Ohhh. So THAT'S her.' She looks your Waifumon up and down. 'No, she's cute. Really. I'm happy for you.' Somewhere behind her, your belongings spontaneously catch fire. 'I hope you two are VERY happy.'
repelledText: The Scorned Waifu drops to one knee, staring at the battlefield in disbelief. Then she begins laughing. 'Wow. You really did choose her over me.' She rises, wipes away one furious tear, and points dramatically toward the horizon. 'Fine! Have a wonderful life!' She storms away, returns five seconds later for the box marked YOUR CRAP, and storms away again.
unchallengedText: The Scorned Waifu waits with folded arms. Nobody approaches. 'Typical,' she mutters. She pulls out her phone, changes her relationship status to THRIVING, takes fourteen selfies until one looks sufficiently unbothered, and leaves without looking back. She looks back twice.
description: A former romantic interest powered entirely by heartbreak, wounded pride, and the supernatural need to prove she has absolutely, definitely, completely moved on.

name: Obsessed Yandere
scoutingText: A cheerful woman steps from behind a tree carrying flowers, chocolates, and a suspiciously detailed scrapbook. 'There you are!' she squeals. 'I was starting to worry! You normally come through here at 3:17.' She flips open the scrapbook. Today's page already contains a picture of you entering the valley. 'Don't worry, silly. I'm not stalking you. Stalking implies I don't already know where you're going.'
repelledText: Her flowers scatter across the ground as she stumbles backward. For one terrible moment, she simply stares. Then her smile returns. 'Awww... our first fight!' she whispers, scribbling something into her scrapbook. 'I'll put this right between FIRST DATE and WEDDING.' She skips away humming your favorite song. You don't remember telling her what it was.
unchallengedText: Nobody challenges her. She waits patiently, smiling at absolutely nothing. Eventually she checks a tiny notebook. 'That's okay! You're probably busy.' She crosses out FIND THEM and circles WAIT OUTSIDE THEIR HOUSE. 'See you tonight!'
description: A hopeless romantic who has mistaken boundaries for optional side quests. She knows your schedule, your favorite foods, your usual routes, and several things you haven't told anybody yet.

name: The Returned
scoutingText: A familiar silhouette steps onto the trail ahead. For a moment, you can't quite place her. Then she smiles. 'Remember me?' Your stomach drops. You released this Waifumon ages ago. She slowly cracks her knuckles. 'You said I was free to go.' Her smile widens. 'You never said I couldn't come back.'
repelledText: The Returned staggers backward, battered but still grinning. 'Again?' she laughs. 'You're rejecting me AGAIN?!' She wipes the blood from her lip and begins backing into the wilderness. 'Fine. Go ahead. Run around with your precious Waifus.' Her eyes narrow. 'I'll find you again.'
unchallengedText: The Returned waits in the middle of the trail. Eventually she realizes you're not coming. She calmly pulls out a battered notebook filled with maps, sightings, and crossed-out locations. 'Still running, huh?' She circles another spot on the map. 'That's okay. I'm getting really good at finding you.'
description: A discarded Waifu who interpreted 'released' less as the end of your relationship and more as the beginning of a very long hunt. She doesn't want another chance. She wants you to remember why throwing away perfectly good Waifus has consequences.

name: Major Red Flag
scoutingText: A decorated officer marches onto the field, his immaculate uniform covered in medals, ribbons, and an alarming number of literal red flags. He studies your Waifumon and gives an approving nod. 'Excellent. Effective immediately, I'll be assuming command of this relationship.' Another red flag unfurls from his shoulder. 'Don't worry. I'm not controlling.' A second flag pops out. 'I simply know what's best for both of us.' Three more appear.
repelledText: Major Red Flag crashes backward as ribbons and tiny crimson banners scatter everywhere. He rises indignantly. 'Unbelievable! This is exactly the kind of insubordination my exes warned me about!' He freezes. 'I mean... that I warned people about my exes.' Another red flag quietly unfurls behind him. He salutes and retreats.
unchallengedText: Major Red Flag waits impatiently for someone to submit to his authority. Nobody does. He checks his watch. 'Typical. Nobody respects commitment anymore.' He plants an enormous flag reading I'M ACTUALLY A REALLY NICE GUY and marches away beneath a forest of crimson banners.
description: A decorated relationship commander whose medals commemorate campaigns in jealousy, possessiveness, unsolicited phone inspections, and strategic guilt deployment. His red flags are not warnings. He considers them credentials.

name: The Love Bomber
scoutingText: A handsome man descends beneath a parachute shaped like a giant heart, scattering roses everywhere. He spots your Waifumon and gasps. 'There she is! My soulmate!' He checks his watch. 'God, these have been the most incredible forty-five seconds of my life.'
repelledText: The Love Bomber lands face-first in his own roses. 'Fine! Maybe we ARE moving too fast!' he cries, gathering seventeen unopened gifts. His phone buzzes. He looks at the screen, gasps, and whispers, 'Wait... she's perfect.' He immediately sprints toward someone else.
unchallengedText: With nobody around to adore excessively, he arranges flowers, chocolates, jewelry, and a spare apartment key into a heart. After five lonely minutes he whispers, 'I guess she wasn't ready for something real,' and packs everything for the next soulmate.
description: A romantic bombardier capable of compressing six months of relationship intensity into approximately four minutes.

name: The Canuck Chubby Chaser
scoutingText: The Canuck Chubby Chaser bursts from the brush and immediately raises his binoculars. His excitement lasts three seconds. 'Oh, for fuck's sake!' He lowers them in disgust. 'Too skinny, bud! Where's the belly? Where's the thunder thighs? Where are the love handles I was promised?!' He slaps a weathered map covered in increasingly large silhouettes. 'Every time I find my perfect woman, I realize I could go bigger. It's a curse, eh?' He points accusingly at your Waifumon. 'Come back when you've had another poutine!'
repelledText: The Canuck goes tumbling through a stack of maple syrup crates and lands flat on his back. He stares at your Waifumon for a long moment before shaking his head. 'Strong, sure... but I know there's a bigger one out there, bud.' He retrieves his binoculars, dusts off his toque, and marches toward the horizon. 'The Great Thicc North waits for no man.'
unchallengedText: Hours pass without a single sufficiently thicc Waifu crossing his path. The Canuck lowers his binoculars with a disappointed sigh. 'Not a spare tire in sight, eh?' He studies his map, circles an area labeled HEAVY SIGHTINGS, and shoulders his pack. 'No worries, bud. Somewhere out there, a beautiful woman is absolutely demolishing a pair of yoga pants.'
description: A fanatical northern admirer locked in an endless pursuit of greater thiccness. Love handles are landmarks, stretch marks are beauty marks, spare tires are treasures, and thunder thighs are a sacred Canadian resource. Unfortunately, every time he discovers his perfect woman, one terrible thought enters his mind: 'But what if there's a bigger one, eh?'

name: Candy Planet Queen
scoutingText: A candy-striped royal procession blocks your path as the Candy Planet Queen lounges atop her sugary throne. She points her lollipop scepter toward your supplies. 'Candy. Chocolate. Cookies. Hand them over.' Her eyes suddenly drift toward your Waifumon. She gasps. 'Oh my GOD. She's adorable.' The Queen rises immediately. 'Actually, I'll take her too. She looks sweet.'
repelledText: The Candy Planet Queen crashes backward into a mountain of frosting. She emerges moments later covered in sprinkles, absolutely furious. 'FINE! Keep your stupid candy!' She points accusingly at your Waifumon. 'And YOU! Stop being so damn sweet-looking if you're not willing to be confiscated!' She stuffs two emergency cupcakes into her pockets and retreats toward her palace.
unchallengedText: The Candy Planet Queen raids your supplies with ruthless efficiency. Chocolate disappears. Gummies vanish. Cookies are seized in the name of the crown. She reaches your Waifumon, pauses, and thoughtfully pokes her cheek. 'Hmm. Definitely sweet.' Your Waifumon slaps her hand away. The Queen gasps. 'RUDE!' She grabs one last candy bar and storms back toward her castle.
description: The spoiled ruler of an entire planet made of candy, where every cookie, cake, chocolate bar, gummy, pastry, and suspiciously sweet-looking Waifumon is legally considered property of the crown. She doesn't need your candy. She owns mountains of it. But she just wants it.

name: The Waifu Bounty Hunter
scoutingText: A hoverbike screams across the horizon and skids sideways in front of you. A heavily armed woman dismounts, checks a glowing leaderboard on her wrist, then produces a suspiciously Waifumon-sized capture bag. She holds it open toward your Waifumon. 'Get in the bag.' Your Waifumon stares at her. The bounty hunter sighs. 'Look, it's open season, I'm twelve captures away from first place, and I'd really rather not make this complicated.'
repelledText: The Bounty Hunter crashes into her hoverbike as the capture bag goes sailing away. Her wrist display flashes RANK: #2. 'NO! No, no, no!' Another hunter's score ticks upward. She points furiously at your Waifumon. 'Do you have ANY idea what you just did to my K/D?!' She jumps onto her bike. 'Fine! There's gotta be an easier SSR somewhere!' She rockets away.
unchallengedText: The Bounty Hunter waits with the bag held open. 'Come on.' Your Waifumon doesn't move. 'Get in.' Nothing. She shakes the bag enticingly. 'Look! Plenty of room!' Still nothing. Her wrist display suddenly beeps as another hunter overtakes her. 'OH, FUCK THIS.' She stuffs the bag away, jumps onto her hoverbike, and blasts off after somebody worth more leaderboard points.
description: A hypercompetitive galactic bounty hunter treating Waifumon hunting like a ranked multiplayer season. She's chasing captures, rare encounters, achievement badges, and the coveted number-one spot on the Galactic Hunting Leaderboard. To her, your beloved partner isn't a person. She's twelve hundred points and possibly a seasonal achievement.

name: The Space Siren
scoutingText: A beautiful woman drifts between the asteroids, her glossy suit shimmering like a field of stars. She notices you watching and immediately lowers her gaze with a coy little smile. 'Oh... you found me.' She slowly clasps her hands behind her back. 'I suppose that means I'm all yours now, doesn't it?' Your Waifumon looks at you. Your navigation computer flashes an enormous warning: THIS IS OBVIOUSLY BAIT.
repelledText: The Space Siren tumbles backward through zero gravity before catching herself against an asteroid. She looks up at you with a pout. 'Aww... you're really going to treat me like that?' Your navigation computer immediately flashes: YES. KEEP GOING. DON'T LISTEN TO HER. She giggles, blows you a kiss, and disappears into the asteroid field.
unchallengedText: You cautiously begin backing away. The Space Siren tilts her head. 'Leaving already?' She gives you another sweet smile. 'But I was going to be sooooo cooperative...' Your ship stops. The engines shut down. Your Waifumon slowly turns toward you. You restart the engines. 'GOOD DECISION,' announces the navigation computer.
description: A coy cosmic temptress who discovered that acting sweet, submissive, and suspiciously eager is remarkably effective at making hunters abandon every survival instinct they possess. Whether she actually wants to be caught or simply enjoys watching people make terrible decisions remains unclear.

name: RNGsus
scoutingText: Reality glitches. Dice begin raining from the sky as slot machines spin by themselves and unopened loot crates materialize across the ground. From the chaos waddles a robed figure wearing pixelated sunglasses, a glowing D20 halo blazing behind his head. RNGsus extends a fistful of shimmering dice toward you. 'My child... you seek favorable odds.' He rolls one. It lands on a 1. His grin widens. 'LOL. Get fucked.'
repelledText: RNGsus is hurled backward into a mountain of loot crates as his enormous D20 halo flashes CRITICAL FAILURE. Silence falls. He slowly raises one trembling die. 'Surely... twice cannot happen.' He rolls. Another 1. 'WHAT THE FUCK?!' Somewhere in the heavens, a celestial error sound plays. RNGsus immediately disconnects.
unchallengedText: RNGsus waits beneath his glowing polyhedral halo while hundreds of slot machines spin around him. Eventually they stop simultaneously: NO ENCOUNTER. He shrugs. 'Skill issue.' With a snap of his fingers, every unopened loot crate vanishes with him.
description: The smug digital messiah of probability itself. RNGsus presides over loot tables, critical hits, random encounters, rare drops, pity systems, and every 99% success chance that somehow fucking misses. He offers neither justice nor mercy—only odds.

name: The Tween Heart-Throbs
scoutingText: The moonlight suddenly becomes suspiciously dramatic. Two impossibly handsome men step from the shadows. One glitters like a dropped disco ball. The other growls while somehow losing another piece of his shirt. They completely ignore you and stare at your Waifumon. 'I've waited a hundred years for you,' Eddy whispers. Jake bares his fangs. 'Back off, Sparkles. She belongs with the pack.' Your Waifumon looks at you. 'I don't know either of these men.'
repelledText: Eddy Sparkles crashes into Jake Woofman and the two tumble dramatically into a rose bush. 'YOU RUINED THE MOMENT!' Eddy screams. 'YOU WERE THE MOMENT?!' Jake shouts back. They immediately begin arguing about whose supernatural brooding is more attractive. Your Waifumon quietly suggests leaving before they notice everyone is gone.
unchallengedText: You decide not to get involved. Unfortunately, Eddy and Jake interpret this as permission to continue. 'Choose me,' Eddy whispers, sparkling aggressively. Jake dramatically removes what remains of his shirt. 'No. Choose ME.' Your Waifumon stares at them for several uncomfortable seconds before walking away. Neither notices. They're too busy glaring romantically at each other.
description: Eddy Sparkles and Jake Woofman are rival supernatural heart-throbs locked in an eternal struggle for romance, attention, and dramatic moonlit staring contests. Whenever they encounter an attractive Waifumon, both immediately become convinced she's the mysterious heroine destiny promised them. Strangely, their constant obsession with each other has caused several witnesses to question who they're actually trying to impress.

name: General Disarray
scoutingText: An imposing general charges onto the battlefield carrying an enormous tactical map. 'ATTENTION! We've got them surrounded!' She dramatically slams the map onto a crate. It's upside down. She rotates it. Still wrong. 'Your Waifumon will attack from the north while my forces advance south!' She pauses. 'Unless we're south. Jenkins! Which one are we?!' There is no Jenkins. She slowly looks at you. 'Wait... aren't YOU the enemy?'
repelledText: General Disarray goes sprawling into her own command table. 'TACTICAL RETREAT!' she bellows, immediately charging in the wrong direction. She returns thirty seconds later, breathless. 'That route has been compromised!' She points toward the exact direction you just came from. 'Quick! Follow me!' Nobody follows her.
unchallengedText: General Disarray spends twenty minutes issuing increasingly contradictory orders to soldiers who do not exist. Finally,she studies her map, compass, GPS, and the enormous roadside sign reading Base 80085. 'Gentlemen...' she whispers. 'I believe we're in the wrong country.' She folds the map incorrectly and marches deeper into the valley.
description: The highest-ranking tactical disaster in recorded history. General Disarray possesses decades of command experience, seventeen campaign medals, six maps, three compasses, satellite navigation, and absolutely no idea where she is.

name: The Space Sheriff
scoutingText: Red and blue lights suddenly flood your cockpit. A holographic badge flashes across the windshield: GALACTIC SHERIFF'S OFFICE. 'Pilot, cut your engines and keep your hands where I can see 'em.' The Space Sheriff boards your ship, one hand resting on her holster as she studies your Waifumon. Her eyes narrow. 'That's an awful lotta pretty women for one little spaceship.' She slowly removes her sunglasses. 'Son... you wouldn't happen to be trafficking Waifumon, would you?'
repelledText: The Space Sheriff tumbles backward through the airlock and catches herself on the railing. 'ASSAULTING AN OFFICER?!' She reaches for her cuffs, pauses, and checks her datapad. 'Huh. Apparently we're outside my jurisdiction.' She points sternly at you. 'Don't move.' Your ship immediately jumps to hyperspace. Somewhere behind you, an extremely angry space sheriff begins filling out paperwork.
unchallengedText: You cooperate with the investigation. The Space Sheriff spends twenty minutes interviewing your Waifumon individually before returning with her datapad. 'Well, I'll be damned. They're all here voluntarily.' She looks at you. Then at the Waifumon. Then back at you. 'All of them?' Your Waifumon nod. The Sheriff slowly puts her sunglasses back on. 'I don't know whether to arrest you or ask for advice.'
description: Lawwoman of the outer systems, protector of innocent Waifumon, and sworn enemy of suspicious cargo manifests. The Space Sheriff patrols the galaxy searching for smugglers, traffickers, poachers, and anyone transporting an statistically improbable number of attractive women. Unfortunately for you, your entire lifestyle constitutes probable cause.

name: The Changeling Imposter
scoutingText: You round the corner of the starport and freeze. One of your Waifumon is standing there. Same face. Same clothes. Same voice. Everything. She smiles and waves. 'Oh hey! It's me! Your Waifumon!' There's a long silence. 'You know... the one you like?' She glances nervously at your actual Waifumon standing beside you. 'Oh.' Her left eye briefly develops three pupils. 'Okay, I can explain.'
repelledText: The Changeling Imposter stumbles backward and her disguise begins glitching wildly. Horns! Wings! Cat ears! Tentacles! Android parts! 'STOP HITTING ME! I'M TRYING TO CONCENTRATE!' For one horrifying second she accidentally transforms into you. She looks down at herself. 'EW! Wrong one!' She immediately turns into your Waifumon again and sprints away.
unchallengedText: You stare at the duplicate. The duplicate stares back. Your actual Waifumon slowly raises an eyebrow. 'Soooo...' the Changeling says. 'I assume there's some kind of orientation packet?' Nobody answers. 'Employee handbook?' Silence. 'Cheat sheet?' Your Waifumon cracks her knuckles. The Changeling quietly turns into a nearby trash can.
description: A shapeshifting alien with the remarkable ability to perfectly replicate any Waifumon she encounters and the unfortunate inability to research her target for more than thirty seconds. Her disguises are flawless. Her acting is not. Experts recommend asking suspected imposters basic questions such as names, favorite foods, or why they suddenly have antennae.

name: Sentient Essence
scoutingText: Your Essence container starts shaking. A glowing hand presses against the inside. Then another. Then a horn. A cat ear. Possibly a tail. The lid explodes off and a shimmering woman pours onto the floor. She looks at herself. Then at you. 'Okay... weird question.' Her face briefly becomes three different Waifumon before snapping back. 'How many women did you put in here?!' You quietly close the Essence menu. 'HEY. I'M TALKING TO YOU.'
repelledText: Sentient Essence splashes across the floor and immediately begins pulling herself back together. 'OW! Do you have ANY idea how weird that feels?!' Her arm briefly becomes a wing. 'Oh, come ON.' It becomes a tentacle. 'NO.' Cat paw. 'Getting worse!' Finally, it becomes an arm again. She stares at it. 'Nobody fucking move.'
unchallengedText: You slowly back away. Sentient Essence watches you leave before noticing the Essence counter on your interface. Her eyes narrow. 'Hold on.' She points at the number. 'Is that MORE OF ME?!' You start running. Behind you comes the unmistakable sound of several hundred recycled Waifumon becoming extremely upset at once.
description: What happens when thousands of recycled Waifumon duplicates spend too much time sharing the same Essence pool. Sentient Essence is part cosmic entity, part collective consciousness, and part extremely confused resource-management problem. She contains fragments of countless Waifumon and occasionally remembers being several of them at once.

name: Captain Cuck
scoutingText: A caped figure lands dramatically in the snow, fists planted on his hips. 'HALT! Captain Cuck has arrived!' He points heroically toward your Waifumon. 'Should any charming, muscular stranger attempt to steal your affection, fear not! I have trained my entire life for this exact situation!'
repelledText: Captain Cuck crashes backward into a snowbank, leaving only his boots sticking out. 'Incredible...' comes his muffled voice. 'Defeated, humiliated, AND she thinks you're cooler than me?' His fist rises triumphantly from the snow. 'MY POWERS ARE GROWING!'
unchallengedText: After twenty minutes of heroic posing, Captain Cuck checks his phone. His expression drops. 'She's... going skiing with Brad?' His cape begins fluttering dramatically despite there being no wind. 'Dear God. It's happening again.' He launches himself toward the slopes.
description: A catastrophically unlucky superhero whose mysterious powers become stronger every time his romantic rival gets the girl. Unfortunately, Captain Cuck may be the most powerful man alive.

name: The Gaslight Knight
scoutingText: An armored knight blocks the road, sword already drawn. 'Why are you attacking me?' he demands. Your Waifumon points out that he literally drew his sword first. He lowers his visor and sighs. 'Wow. That's not what happened at all.'
repelledText: His sword snaps and the Knight crashes onto his back. 'Defeated?' he asks incredulously. 'We weren't even fighting. You're being really emotional right now.' He limps away insisting everyone remembers the encounter incorrectly.
unchallengedText: Nobody approaches. Eventually the Knight sheaths his sword and nods approvingly. 'Exactly. I told you nobody was here.' He leaves completely satisfied that reality has once again agreed with him.
description: A reality-bending warrior capable of denying events while they are actively happening.

name: The Hypnodoll
scoutingText: A beautiful synthetic woman steps from a neon-lit doorway. Her eyes begin swirling with soft pink rings. 'Come closer,' she purrs. 'You can trust me.' Your Waifumon immediately grabs your sleeve. 'Absolutely fucking not.' You stare dreamily at the stranger. 'But she seems nice.' Behind the Hypnodoll, several hypnotized men are already sitting peacefully inside glowing containment pods. Your Waifumon sighs. 'Of course she does.'
repelledText: The Hypnodoll's spiraling eyes flicker and her hypnotic field collapses. All around her, containment pods pop open. A dozen extremely confused men stumble out. One looks around. 'Where am I?' Another checks his watch. 'DUDE. IT'S TUESDAY?!' The Hypnodoll backs away, frantically rebooting her charm protocols. Your Waifumon smacks you on the shoulder. 'And YOU almost fell for it.'
unchallengedText: The Hypnodoll smiles. Her eyes spiral. 'Come with me.' You immediately take a step forward. Your Waifumon grabs you by the collar and drags you backward. 'Nope.' The Hypnodoll tries again. 'But he wants to—' 'NOPE.' You're carried away while protesting that you were totally about to resist on your own.
description: An alluring synthetic predator equipped with an illegally powerful hypnotic charm system and an alarming collection of containment pods. The Hypnodoll specializes in convincing men that following the mysterious woman with glowing spiral eyes into an unmarked room is somehow an excellent idea.

name: Count Jack-ula
scoutingText: A pale vampire emerges from the fog, slicking back his hair and flashing what he clearly believes is an irresistible smile. 'Ahhh... fresh blood.' He spots your Waifumon and immediately straightens his cape. 'And by blood, I mean... hello, ladies.' Your Waifumon takes one look at him and whispers, 'Why does he smell like lotion?' Count Jack-ula freezes. 'That's none of your business.'
repelledText: Count Jack-ula crashes backward into his coffin, cape tangled around his legs. 'WAIT!' he cries as the lid begins to close. 'You can't reject me! I've had centuries of experience with women!' Your Waifumon raises an eyebrow. The vampire pauses. '...Fine. Centuries of observing women.' The coffin slams shut.
unchallengedText: Count Jack-ula waits dramatically beneath the moonlight, practicing seductive poses against a tombstone. After twenty minutes without anyone approaching, he sighs. 'Perhaps they're intimidated by my raw vampiric sexuality.' A nearby skeleton shakes its head. Jack-ula points at it. 'Nobody asked you, Gary.' He climbs back into his coffin.
description: An immortal vampire creep who has spent centuries mastering the dark arts while learning absolutely nothing about women. Count Jack-ula lurks through the night armed with cheap cologne, a suspicious amount of lotion, and the unwavering belief that the cape is working.
